newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Pacific Ports debuts at HK$3.60/share.
newsitem.headline: Pacific Ports debuts at HK$3.60/share.

text.p: Shares of Pacific Ports Co Ltd, the port operating arm of Fairyoung Holdings Ltd, debuted at HK$3.60 per share on Friday compared with the issue price of HK$3.09.

Pacific Ports offered 200 million shares at HK$3.09 each in flotation, of which 160 million shares were placed with institutional and professional investors and 40 million shares offered to the public in Hong Kong.
The public portion of the offer was 141 times subscribed.
The company said it had issued 30 million new shares to cover over-allotment.
Pacific Ports is engaged in investment, development, operation and management of terminals in seaports and riverports in Asia.
It holds the development rights for five port infrastructure projects in Xiamen in China's Fujian province, and in Nanjing and Suzhou in Jiangsu province.

The company said net proceeds raised from the issue would be about HK$583 million, of which HK$460 million would be used to invest in its ports and related projects in China over the next three years. The rest would be used as working capital.
